proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  have h2a : (2 * a) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero ha
  have e : ∀ x : ℝ, a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = a * (x * x) + b * x + c := by
    intro x
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hD
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hD
    have hss : discrim a b c = Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) * Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) := by
      rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt hD.le, discrim]
    have hset : {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = 0} = {(-b + Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a), (-b - Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a)} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      rw [e]
      exact quadratic_eq_zero_iff ha hss x
    rw [hset]
    apply Set.ncard_pair
    intro h
    have := (div_left_inj' h2a).1 h
    linarith
  · intro hD
    have hset : {x : ℝ | a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c = 0} = {-b / (2 * a)} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      rw [e]
      exact quadratic_eq_zero_iff_of_discrim_eq_zero ha (by rw [discrim]; exact hD) x
    rw [hset]
    exact Set.ncard_singleton _
  · intro hD
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro hx
    have h : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c = (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2 := by linear_combination (-4 * a) * hx
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * a * x + b)]
